# Sprint 0 data fixtures (DO NOT EDIT)

Generated by the Sprint 0 baseline code (commit `cb86d24`, catalog `prompter.core@0.1.0`,
ImageSpec `0.1.0`) before any Sprint 1 change. Used by compatibility tests to prove that
data saved/exported by Sprint 0 loads losslessly in later versions.

- `export-full.json` — JSON export with free text (Korean + English), subject, style
- `export-empty.json` — JSON export of an empty spec
- `export-all-options.json` — 8 specs covering every Sprint 0 subject and style option id
- `localstorage-workspace.txt` — raw `prompter:v1:workspace` localStorage value
